name: Recognise a repeating pattern
description: Student can recognise a repeating pattern in objects, shapes, sounds or movements.
exampleOfSuccess: Hearing clap, stamp, clap, stamp, the student says it is a repeating pattern.
commonError: Student calls a random sequence a pattern, or only recognises patterns of colour.
checkpointTask: Show or perform two sequences, one repeating and one not. Ask which is a repeating pattern.

name: Copy a repeating pattern
description: Student can copy a repeating pattern made by someone else.
exampleOfSuccess: Shown red, blue, red, blue with blocks, the student builds the same pattern.
commonError: Student copies only the first few items, or copies the colours in the wrong order.
checkpointTask: Make a repeating pattern. Ask the student to copy it with their own materials.

name: Continue a repeating pattern
description: Student can continue a repeating pattern.
exampleOfSuccess: Given circle, triangle, circle, triangle, the student adds circle, triangle.
commonError: Student adds items that do not follow the repeat, or stops partway through the repeating part.
checkpointTask: Start three repeating patterns. Ask the student to continue each.

name: Describe a repeating pattern
description: Student can describe a repeating pattern in words.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says the pattern is 'red, blue, red, blue, and it keeps going'.
commonError: Student names the items but does not notice or say what repeats.
checkpointTask: Show a repeating pattern. Ask the student to describe it.

name: Make a repeating pattern in a different way
description: Student can show a repeating pattern using different materials, sounds or movements.
exampleOfSuccess: Shown red, red, blue with blocks, the student claps it as clap, clap, jump.
commonError: Student copies the materials exactly rather than the repeating structure.
checkpointTask: Show a repeating pattern. Ask the student to make the same pattern using sounds or movements.
